interface.longDescription:
How it works

Build apps and websites with AI, using Alpy’s customizable design system and UI, UX, and web design skills. Your connected Alpy Library brings design tokens, React and Vue components, and website styles into ChatGPT and Codex to guide consistent, distinctive interfaces.

Start with an idea, a reference, or an existing interface. Your AI helps clarify the goals, audience, content, and constraints. Approve the brief and visual direction before building, then review and refine the result with Alpy’s design guidance.

What else can you do?

Create polished websites and apps
Use Alpy to create a polished website or app. Clarify the brief and visual direction, then build a responsive preview.

Build a design system
Use Alpy Library’s tokens and components to build a consistent design system for this app.

Improve existing designs
Use Alpy to refine UI, UX, typography, usability, and accessibility while preserving its core functionality.

What’s included

User interface skills
Shape clear layouts, readable typography, balanced spacing, and consistent visual details with the interface design skills listed in the Skills section below.
